svg.title: Participants and roles for each claim
svg.desc: The access seeker (example: visitor) sends the authorized age-threshold answer to the resource controller (example: museum). The access seeker is Subject and Holder for that claim, and the resource controller is Verifier and Relying Party. The resource controller sends authorized controller evidence to the access seeker, reversing those roles for that claim. An Issuer can be another party or the Subject itself; the latter is self-issued. The Verifier checks the claimed Issuer's evidence. Data, Facet, Credential and Receipt are associated objects. Both participants authenticate, decide disclosure and keep their own minimal Receipt.
svg.text: Two participants, equals in the exchange: each requests, presents, checks and decides
Subject + Holder: access seeker / Verifier + Relying Party: resource controller
Subject + Holder: resource controller / Verifier + Relying Party: access seeker
Issuer: another party, or the Subject itself (self-issued)
The Verifier checks the claimed Issuer's evidence.
Objects used under UM's disclosure and permission rules
Both participants authenticate, decide disclosure and keep their own minimal Receipt.
